title: Cults3D - Scan d'une porte G-body avec adaptation de poignee 993
notes: La fiche vend un STL de 2266,18 x 573,24 x 1033,44 mm de porte G-body avec vitre laterale, adaptation de poignee 993 et cadre de vitre de Targa. Le vendeur decrit un scan haute resolution pour restauration et fabrication, tout en demandant de verifier les dimensions avant fabrication. Le panneau est modifie et ne represente pas une porte 993 OEM; achat, licence et comparaison a la piece reelle sont obligatoires. Piste de reference exterieure, jamais interface de fabrication seule. 2026-10-15: the declared 2266.18 mm length is implausible for a side door. It is more than half of the 4,245 mm overall length and almost equal to the 2,272 mm wheelbase recorded in SRC-ASTRA-993-TYPE-APPROVAL-DIMENSIONS, while a door sits between the wheel arches. The declared envelope therefore signals an unresolved unit, scale or export problem, and dimensional_accuracy moves from declared to unknown. The real door length is not sourced here. On 2026-10-15 the Cults page was not read: cults3d.com served its robots.txt behind a Cloudflare bot challenge (HTTP 403), so permission for automated agents could not be established and the page was not requested.
